title: Temporary Rate Reduction Plan Rate Card for Documented Hardship
content:
**Rule.** For a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the documented-hardship rate is set by the hardship reason on the request and the documents recorded on it: a request for medical hardship or death of a household earner with a medical bill or a death certificate recorded on it uses 2.99 percent; a request for reduced income with at least 2 income statements recorded on it uses 3.99 percent; any other request uses the program's plan rate. A document counts when it is recorded on the request as a document received.

## Rate card

| Hardship reason | Documents recorded on the request | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| medical hardship or death of a household earner | a medical bill or a death certificate | 2.99 percent |
| reduced income | 2 or more income statements | 3.99 percent |
| reduced income | 1 income statement | the program's plan rate |
| divorce or separation | any | the program's plan rate |
| medical hardship or death of a household earner | no medical bill or death certificate | the program's plan rate |
